editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher article text, critic scores and tasting notes are never copied or redistributed; Swoon'd writes its own explanations, names works and people as facts, and links to the original.

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: She can talk about what she loves in a glass, follow a wine list and a label without panic, pair a bottle sensibly with dinner, ask a couple of good questions, treat a 'not tonight' with warmth, and say 'okay, I get why you love this' without faking it.

licensingConstraints.constraint: Procedural or original illustrations only (license original-swoond); no real winery labels, bottle photographs, vineyard or estate photography, or trade dress. Any label in a drill is fictional.
Original or synthesized pronunciation and sound clips only; no video, podcast or documentary audio; verify text-to-speech licence terms.
Wineries, brands, Champagne houses, critics' publications and certification bodies appear as text mentions and link-outs only, no logos. Protected geographic names are used as facts.
No embedded video; deep-link to official pages.
Publisher articles, tasting notes and critic scores are never copied or reproduced; Swoon'd writes its own examples and links to sources (spec sections 11 and 40).

OIV and trade statistics cited as facts with links (verify reuse terms); Open-Meteo, NOAA and Copernicus need terms review before commercial use; no price, ratings or inventory feeds (Wine-Searcher, Vivino, Liv-ex and critic databases are proprietary, no scraping).
Real sommeliers, winemakers and critics are named as facts only; no likeness, no fabricated quotes, no endorsement implication.

Alcohol-content policies: the course is age-gated by the app (legal drinking age in the learner's jurisdiction) and must meet App Store and Google Play alcohol-content rules; no marketing, sales or delivery features.

safetyConstraints: Age-restricted: available only after the app confirms the learner is of legal drinking age in their jurisdiction (21 in the United States); under-age users never see the course. Learners of legal age who do not drink are welcome.
Appreciation first and non-drinker-friendly: no lesson requires consumption; every tasting item has a smell-only, read-only or skip path; 'no' and 'not tonight' are complete answers.

Never encourage heavy drinking: no drinking games, speed, challenges, tolerance or 'finish the bottle' content; no streaks, XP or badges tied to drinking; toasts stop at one; taught pours are small (about 5 fl oz or 150 ml, five per 750 ml bottle); eat, drink water, pace, and never drive after drinking.

No health, nutrition or medical claims (no 'healthy', 'antioxidant', calorie, diet or weight-loss framing), and no claims about sulfites and headaches; Swoon'd links to official guidance (US 2025-2030 Dietary Guidelines advise consuming less alcohol for better overall health, without numeric limits) and does not restate numbers as medical advice. Verify at release.

Pregnancy, medication, recovery and health conditions: one fixed neutral line (some people should not drink at all; if that is her, skip it and ask a clinician); Swoon'd never asks about anyone's health and never pressures.
Offer, never push: talk tracks and scenarios penalize pressuring someone to drink; no scenario asks why someone is not drinking.
Sparkling service safety: hold the cork, twist the bottle, point it away from people, never saber; bottles are under pressure.
Discreet mode on by default: notifications never contain the Person's name or mention alcohol on the lock screen; no analytics event carries the Person's name or drinking preferences.
Swoon'd builds appreciation and understanding, not a substitute for sommelier training; never encourage the learner to fake expertise or credentials.
